limitations: All reviewers share one model family and task materials; repeated ratings are correlated, not 16 humans or population samples.
Short input sequences and screenshots do not establish complete state/event/input/terminal parity, FPS invariance, calibrated difficulty, defect recall, diversity, or human experience.
Budget and exact snapshot are unverified; task runtime usage from host agents is unavailable.
Blinding is procedural; visual/input architecture may reveal source.
Human intentions/outcomes are unmeasured; gd-108 comparison preparation must be assessed separately and does not require actual recruitment.
Presentation-order groups were scheduled in numeric batches; order and batch effects are not independently isolated.
A post-hoc Sokoban restart audit compares captured initial/before/after snapshots; it is a descriptive check of the existing restart requirement, not a new primary metric.
Raw proxy judgments may misread screenshots/state transitions; retain disagreements and prioritize captured behavior over self-awarded PASS claims.
Browser live render loops coexist with advanceTime inputs; initial simulation ticks are not aligned across candidates, so do not infer FPS parity, difficulty, win-rate or speed advantage.
Proxy sessions open each candidate UI default scenario; the complete paired public seed/profile/repeat matrix is not executed and UI defaults are not certified as seed-matched.
No automatic certification of Skill gain or v1 readiness from proxy preferences.
